hypothesis: Binary FSQ quantization of H1/H2 memory tokens discretizes representations, making them more robust and interpretable, while the STE preserves gradient flow to the encoder.
controlled_delta: Replaces the soft softmax(dim=-1) nonlinearity on H1/H2 memory tokens with FSQ round-and-STE (levels=2). Learning rate reduced from 3e-4 to 2e-4. Everything else identical to the killed critic-dominant run.

fsq.backward: identity gradient where 0 <= H <= 1, zero outside

architecture.routing: X queries [X,H1_prev]; H1_prev queries [H1_prev,Z]; H2_prev queries [H2_prev,H1]

required_canary_evidence: H1/H2 outputs are binary {0,1} after FSQ
gradient flows to encoder through STE
finite tensors and zero skipped updates
weighted objective hierarchy critic > actor > JEPA preserved
falsification: Reject if FSQ kills gradient flow (encoder gradients vanish), behavior collapses to immediate declaration, or correctness fails to exceed the older 64-67% range.
